# AzaharFrame tabmenu: the in-game menu's content, layout and drawing (Material 3 on the UI
# canvas). No emulator or OpenXR dependencies. md3_fonts.h is generated by
# steam-frame/dev/make-md3-fonts.py.
if (NOT TARGET frame_xr_ui)
    add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../ui ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ui)
endif()

add_library(frame_xr_menu STATIC
    md3.cpp
    md3.h
    md3_fonts.h
    tab_menu.cpp
    tab_menu.h
)
target_link_libraries(frame_xr_menu PUBLIC frame_xr_ui)
target_compile_features(frame_xr_menu PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
